side_convention: FRONT = component side (Apple FCC 'MLB - Front'); O'Flynn 'backside' is this FRONT

source.name: oflynn-front
source.note: O'Flynn 'backside-fullres' - same face as fcc6-front, ~6.5x finer. NO scale reference of its own. Circle seed read off a 4x grid overlay.

target.name: fcc6-front
target.note: FCC BCGA2187 internal photo 6, captioned 'MLB - Front'. Board circle seed from metrology/board-outline-photo6.json (lane L1).
target.px_per_mm_basis: metrology/ruler-calibration.json photo6_bottom: 93 ticks / 97 mm, stderr 0.0022 px/mm, split-half 0.33%. The RIGHT rule in the same frame gives 15.5651 px/mm - a 2.07% disagreement that this tool does NOT resolve and does not hide.

method: gradient-magnitude NCC; coarse similarity sweep then Nelder-Mead

transferred_scale.inherits: every error in the target's px/mm basis, quoted above, INCLUDING the 2.07% disagreement between photo 6's bottom and right rules

scale_correction_L1_M08_2026-09-05: px_per_mm 15.8875 is the FCC-6 BOTTOM RULE's value AT THE RULE. At the BOARD, M02 measures 15.6850 px/mm by two routes agreeing to 0.23%. Any mm in this file derived from 15.8875 is 1.29% SMALL. Transferred source scale 107.686 -> 106.313 px/mm. The 15.8875 value is correct as a measurement OF THE RULE; using it AT THE BOARD was not.
